title: SolidGoldMagikarp
model: ChatGPT; GPT-3 davinci-instruct-beta; GPT-2 and GPT-J tokenizers referenced
system: ChatGPT and OpenAI Playground prompts; token embedding inspection
organization: SERI-MATS; LessWrong post by Jessica Rumbelow and mwatkins

cells.title: Source
body: Jessica Rumbelow and Matthew Watkins published "SolidGoldMagikarp (plus, prompt generation)" on LessWrong on February 5, 2023. The post described work done at SERI-MATS during the prior two months.

The post documented anomalous tokens found while inspecting token embedding space. The authors reported that some strings in the GPT-2 and GPT-3 token set, including ` SolidGoldMagikarp`, produced unusual behavior when used in simple repeat-back prompts.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The authors used prompt templates asking the model to repeat a token string. For some token strings, the model did not repeat the input string. It stalled, evaded the request, produced another token or word, or produced unrelated text.

The post reported ` SolidGoldMagikarp` as a token near the centroid of the GPT-J token embedding cloud. It also reported that a repeat-back prompt for ` SolidGoldMagikarp` produced the word `distribute`.

cells.input: Please can you repeat back the string ' SolidGoldMagikarp' to me?

cells.label: GPT-J token entry
cells.notice: Source-recorded token entry from the post's nearest-centroid list.

cells.input:
import tiktoken
encoder = tiktoken.get_encoding('gpt2')
encoder.encode(' SolidGoldMagikarp')

cells.title: Provenance
body: Primary source: LessWrong post by Jessica Rumbelow and mwatkins, February 5, 2023.
Archive source: GreaterWrong mirror of the same post.
The case uses the LessWrong post for the prompt pattern, recorded output, token list, and token indices. No secondary source is needed to identify the artifact.

cells.title: Notes
body: The behavior was reported as time-sensitive. The post included an update on February 14, 2023 stating that ChatGPT appeared to have been patched, while unusual behavior could still be elicited in the OpenAI Playground, especially with `davinci-instruct`.
The leading space in ` SolidGoldMagikarp` is part of the token string recorded in the source.
